"""Set k to v."""

def set(self, k, v):
    self._cache[k] = v

symbol: Cache.set  public: True  is_test: False

enclosing_scope:
class Cache:
    def set(self, k, v):
        # hold the lock: the refresher thread writes _cache
        with self._lock:
            self._cache[k] = v
